sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/south-brush-creek-campground (Medicine Bow NF, read 2026-11-20): 'located on the west side of the Snowy Range along the shore of South Brush Creek ... composed of two sections located in a dense stand of Lodgepole pines, fir and Aspen'; 'The campground has 20 sites, with 6 pull-through sites for trailers under 25 feet.'; 'toilets, trash service, and a camp host on site, and water is available late May through mid September'; 'Open season is June - September.'; 'Open seasonally, weather dependent.'; 'Single Site: $20 per night / Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per day'; 'Vault Toilet (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'Make Reservations Here'; FS point 41.3444,-106.4959 (~600 m east of the sites)

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10156047 (read 2026-11-20): phone (307) 326-5258; notice 'There are no hookup services. Maximum length of stay is 14 days. ... Campsites are limited to 8 people and 2 vehicles per site. Only 1 RV/trailer per RV campsite.'; rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, maxConsecutiveStay 16, minConsecutiveStay 1 soft, reservationCutOff 7

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10156047/rates (read 2026-11-20): Peak Season 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-07 PeakStandardNonelectric $20; Peak 2027-06-01 to 2027-09-07 $20; First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-31 WalkInStandardNonelectric $20

recreation.gov campsite catalog (api/search/campsites asset 10156047, read 2026-11-20): 20 sites, all nonelectric, no water hookup; 9 reservable (011, 012, 014-020; 020 typed TENT ONLY), 11 first-come (001-010, 013); pull-throughs 002, 006, 011, 016, 018; every site permits RV/Trailer, no lengths posted

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (280 m and 110 m half-width, catalog site points plotted): two sections along FR 200 north of the creek; site centroid ~41.3443,-106.5028; stored pin 41.3444,-106.50367 is ~75 m west of it inside the west section - no move. South Brush Creek (two narrow channels, a few metres each) runs ~22-27 m south of sites 015-018 across grass and a willow/shrub fringe

note: Medicine Bow NF campground about 20 mi southeast of Saratoga off WY-130 via FR 100 and FR 200, in two sections among lodgepole pine, fir and aspen beside South Brush Creek. --Claude
